svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Infra view, cluster prod-eu-1 (L2) with node packing (L3)
svg.desc: Infra view of cluster prod-eu-1 grouped by node pool. Each node cell packs its pods by request size, coloured by health; the Capacity layer tints nodes by usage vs request. Node ip-10-4-9-17 is under MemoryPressure and is expanded into the L3 packing view (request vs usage vs limit). A floors indicator shows the app floor above the infra floor with runs-on threads for checkout.
